title: Custom GitHub agent repositories missing (#3861)
reality: v2.3.4 adds disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to the Agents Manager (#3861): a third-party agent-source path alongside the official catalog, with manual preview/apply (no auto-sync), an explicit trust confirmation before a repo is used, a stable sync identity per repo (a customAgentRepositorySource key exists in agent settings and is stripped on transfer), and bounded SSRF-safe archive validation. agents.md currently presents Download Agents as exclusively official.
fix: Add a 'Custom agent repositories (2.3.4)' subsection under 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)' documenting: disabled by default, added in Agents Manager, manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, bounded SSRF-safe archive validation (#3861). Soften the 'official packages' exclusivity wording.

title: Agent import/export hardening not reflected (#3953)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953) hardened agent transfer: imported agent files can no longer install bundled custom functions, grant themselves tool access (verified in packages/client/src/lib/agent-transfer.ts: sanitizeAgentSettingsForImport deletes settings.enabledTools — 'Imported agents never receive tool access from the file they came from'), or overwrite a curated Agent by reusing its internal type; imports get a fresh custom identity (createImportedAgentType → 'custom-import-<slug>-<suffix>') and the user must review and explicitly re-attach tools. Exports no longer bundle function definitions.
fix: Update the 'Exporting & importing agents (v2.0)' section: keep JSON/folder-zip formats but add a (2.3.4, #3953) note — exports omit function definitions; imports arrive with tool access stripped and always receive a fresh custom-import identity so they cannot impersonate or overwrite curated agents by type reuse.

title: Background agent no longer generates backgrounds
reality: v2.3.4 removed the Background agent's obsolete image-generation toggle and runtime path: it now ONLY selects existing library backgrounds. Illustrator owns automatic and Gallery background generation; the Roleplay Gallery's Background action routes through Illustrator's background prompt mode (#3809), and Gallery-generated backgrounds are applied to the active Roleplay chat.
fix: Edit the `background` entry to say it selects from existing library backgrounds only — image-generation toggle/runtime removed in 2.3.4 — and add to the `illustrator` entry that the Gallery Background action routes through Illustrator's background prompt mode (#3809) and applies the result to the active Roleplay chat.

title: Generated agent registry file deleted (#3847/#3848)
reality: v2.3.4 contract cleanup (#3847, #3848) removed obsolete generated registries, unused agent/turn-game contract members, duplicate tool arrays, Visual Novel types, and chat-mode definitions while preserving legacy downloadable-agent package parsing. Verified: agent-registry.generated.ts returns 404 on main but 200 at tag v2.3.3. The empty built-in list now lives in packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts as BUILT_IN_AGENTS (populated at runtime from package manifests); BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS (21 entries) and RETIRED_BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS survive there.
fix: In the Source of truth paragraph, drop agent-registry.generated.ts / BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS; cite the empty BUILT_IN_AGENTS array in types/agent.ts and note the (2.3.4) #3847/#3848 cleanup.
